search_lines.select: l.id, l.startAt AS at, COALESCE(l.speakerName,l.speakerTag,'某人') AS title, l.text AS quote
search_lines.where: (l.eventId IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memory_events e WHERE e.id=l.eventId AND e.deleted=0))
speaker: l.speakerName
l.speakerTag

search_events.select: e.id, e.startAt AS at, e.title, e.summary, e.pointsJson AS points, e.peopleJson AS people, COALESCE((SELECT group_concat(text, char(10)) FROM (SELECT text FROM transcript_lines WHERE eventId=e.id ORDER BY startAt,id)),'') AS quote

get_day.select: e.id, e.startAt AS at, e.title, e.summary, e.pointsJson AS points, e.peopleJson AS people, COALESCE((SELECT group_concat(text, char(10)) FROM (SELECT text FROM transcript_lines WHERE eventId=e.id ORDER BY startAt,id)),'') AS quote

list_items.select: i.id, e.startAt AS at, i.category AS title, i.content AS summary, i.status, i.dueText, COALESCE((SELECT group_concat(text, char(10)) FROM (SELECT text FROM transcript_lines WHERE eventId=i.eventId ORDER BY startAt,id)), (SELECT l.text FROM transcript_lines l WHERE l.id=i.lineId),'') AS quote
list_items.table: memory_items i JOIN memory_events e ON e.id=i.eventId
